description: Checks an IPv4 address against the CI Army (CINS Score) bad-IP list, a collective-intelligence list of addresses that recently showed hostile activity across a sensor network (about 15,000 entries). Listed means it is on the current list; the list is a snapshot. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_ciarmy_bad_ips
title: Security Ciarmy Bad Ips
